rows.q: Can I cancel my order and get full refund?
rows.answer:
Yes, you can cancel your order and get a full refund in the following situations: 
1. If you cancel free of charge within 60 seconds of placing the order, you will receive a full refund to your original payment method [2]. 
2. If the restaurant or OrderPal cancels your order for any reason, you will get a full refund including delivery fees, packaging charges, and taxes, along with a ₹50 OrderPal Wallet credit [1]. 
3. For scheduled orders, you can cancel free of charge up to 30 minutes before the scheduled time [5]. 
4. If your order is out for delivery, it cannot be cancelled from the app, but if it is delayed beyond 30 minutes past the promised time, support can cancel it with a full refund [3].

rows.q: late order
rows.answer:
If your order arrives late, the following compensation applies based on the delay: 
- **10 to 30 minutes late:** You receive ₹30 OrderPal Wallet credit automatically within 1 hour [1].
- **More than 30 minutes late:** The delivery fee is refunded, and you can cancel the order for free if it has not been delivered yet [1]. Support can also cancel it with a full refund [2].
- **More than 60 minutes late:** The entire order is refunded, and you can still keep the food if it arrives [1].

Note that the on-time promise does not apply during heavy rain or severe weather (if a weather banner is shown), if you changed the delivery address after placing the order, or for large orders above ₹3,000 [3].
